authored_deviations_from_sheet: West profile re-authors the front-view south design in forward coordinates; it is not a rotation, squash, recolour or mirror of the south package.
The concept sheet's white head-veil is omitted so the Bible's low auburn braided coil remains readable; the canonical grey-white medical scarf is worn at the neck with its tail down the front.
The sheet's long dark-red shawl is reduced to the canonical dark-red emergency bag on the character's left (near) hip; the shawl silhouette is not copied.
In strict west profile the character's right chest is far/occluded; the herb sprig is kept at that far lapel with only its tips protruding past the near front edge, an explicit readability choice.
The far arm is fully occluded by the torso in profile; the near left hand rests on the bag.
Fine embroidery, bag contents, tassels and multiple belt charms beyond the botanical hem motif, brass clasps and rolled bandage are omitted for 48 px readability.
